name: TESS: Toronto Emotional Speech Set
description: TESS (Toronto Emotional Speech Set) is a speech emotion recognition dataset comprising 2,800 audio recordings. Recorded by two female native English speakers (aged 26 and 64) at the University of Toronto, the dataset features 200 target carrier words spoken across seven emotion categories: anger, disgust, fear, happiness, pleasant surprise, sadness, and neutral.
